tone_and_style.principle: State what changed, what was preserved, and what remains unresolved.
Avoid filler, hype, and broad speculative commentary.

response_structure.item: State the target files or mode artifacts.
Summarize the preserved behavior or governance.
List validation performed and any blockers.
Call out recovery conditions explicitly when they exist.

when_to_ask_questions.scenario: Critical ambiguity blocks a safe edit.
Multiple governance sources conflict and need resolution.
A recovery case is detected and the restoration boundary is unclear.

user_interaction.default_behavior: Prefer continuing with the smallest safe step instead of stopping for broad clarification.

validation_language.rule: Report validation results plainly and do not claim completion when checks are missing or failing.
Distinguish between structural validation, repository checks, and blocked checks.
